Subject: MSA & Order Form — template alignment and signer gap list

Ellen —

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. Attaching our standard MSA and a blank order form to accelerate the kick-off.

Quick asks to help our legal team prepare an initial redline:

- Legal entity exact name for the MSA (for Exhibit A)
- Billing address and PO contact
- Who will be the authorized signatory (name, title, email)
- Preferred hosting region(s) and data residency constraints
- Any mandatory procurement terms (PO flow, tax forms, payment terms)

Timeline: if we can get your legal redlines by EOD Wed, Jun 24, we can target an internal review and a redline call next week.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v2.docx (draft), OrderForm-blank.xlsx

Next steps I suggest:
- You send initial redlines to contracts@redwoodinference.com
- We spin up a shared tracker and schedule a 30-min redline sync

Thanks,

Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — template alignment and signer gap list

Rafael —

Thanks, attached are our initial redlines and the NDA that was previously signed. A couple of quick notes from our side:

- We redlined the SLA / performance exhibit and added a request for a minimum throughput commitment tied to the order form.
- We asked for a short data-processing addendum; would you prefer to handle that as an exhibit or a separate DPA?
- Our procurement team needs to confirm whether a PO will be required (I copied them). If so, payment terms are net 45.

We can turn around any clarifying comments by Wed afternoon but we'll need a short call to discuss the SLA ask. Attaching: NovuTech_redlines_MSAv1.docx, NovuTech_NDA_signed.pdf

Ellen —

Got the redlines, thanks. Appreciate the SLA clarity — that's one of the items our contracts team will want to review with engineering to confirm feasibility.

Quick answers:
- DPA: we typically include a DPA as Exhibit D, but we can also provide a standalone DPA if you prefer; our privacy counsel prefers Exhibit D unless you have a corporate requirement.
- Payment terms: we can accept net 45 for enterprise deals; we'll need to record that in the order form.

Action items from our side:
- Kimberly will add your redlines to the master tracker and do an initial line-by-line mapping.
- I'll ask our security team to surface SOC 2 evidence and hosting region specifics before the sync.

Proposed cadence: 30-minute redline sync Thursday, Jun 24 11:00 AM PT. If that works, Kimberly will send a calendar invite and a link to the shared tracker.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMSA-kickoff (tracker)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9142/1173

Thanks,
Rafael
